caption:
Saying no feels like betrayal because your brain learned that being needed = being loved. The guilt after a boundary isn't proof you were wrong. It's proof you're rewiring.

The Guilt Sentence is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "DETOX" to get it.

Save this for the next time you feel guilty for having a boundary. Send it to someone who says yes when they mean no.

#peoplepleasing #boundaries #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: I said NO for the first time in months.
